BiblicalUsage: Baal-hazor was the place where Absalom kept his sheep-shearers, and where he invited all the king's sons to the feast — and had Amnon killed. A shearing feast that turned into a murder, and the name of the place is all that marks it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Baal-hazor shows how revenge dresses itself up as a feast, and Absalom's table is my warning that a grudge served sweet is still poison.
